entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained. C_CNST <- G_CEN C2a total, 14,404 -> 7,973 (-6,431, -44.6%; z 0.554; free low; binding: gov.c2.total (target 31,21,027, balanced 31,21,028, at its upper edge); gov.c2a.centre_own_output (target 8,74,272, balanced 7,86,844, at its lower edge); gfce.c_cnst (target 1,15,147, balanced 1,15,146, at its lower edge)). The Centre/State split of GFCE in each commodity is a RAS on cash functional seeds with the Centre's own-output column set by factors' F4b CE key (assumption A-C2a-2, government-7). That puts the Centre's own-output GFCE above its cash functional revenue expenditure, while RBI State Finances show the States spending about 3.3 lakh more than the SAM writes for them (government-27); the prior leaves G_CEN -2,98,948 and G_STA 4,50,426. Balancing moved 87,427 of GFCE from the Centre to the States, each commodity total held by production's gfce bands and GFCE by gov.c2.total; the Centre's own output ends at 7,86,844, the lower edge of gov.c2a.centre_own_output (target 8,74,272, -10%): toward, not past, the cash evidence. The split by commodity below the column has no evidence of its own (the low-confidence construction and utilities entries move most). GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 16,151.

entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained. C_CNST <- K_GCEN I1a total, 4,26,714 -> 4,10,458 (-16,256, -3.8%; z 0.962; free medium; binding: cf.i1a.gfcf.gg (target 12,22,623, balanced 12,22,622, at its lower edge); gfcf.c_cnst (target 54,26,853, balanced 54,26,854, at its upper edge)). The GG and FC capital accounts close through their saving priors, which balancing moved (K3a: the Centre down, the States up, toward FSF; K2a: banks down, NBFCs up). The GFCF, G-sec and loan totals are held (cf.i1a.gfcf.gg, production's gfcf.c_cnst, the cf.k8.* issuance totals), so only this block's keys can move: the Centre/State GFCF key (capital_financial-11, which leaves out ULB capital expenditure 1,07,404 and CSS spending outside State treasuries, both of which point the same way) and the issuer-vs-holder G-sec and deposit splits (capital_financial-29). The moves are a few per cent. GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 4,35,948.
